mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, apt_seq AS aptSeq, apt_name AS aptName, address, pyung, deal_amount AS dealAmount, created_at AS createdAt FROM favorite_apartments WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite_apartments (user_id, apt_seq, apt_name, address, pyung, deal_amount, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{aptSeq}, #{aptName}, #{address}, #{pyung}, #{dealAmount}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite_apartments WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite_apartments WHERE user_id = #{userId}
